# retrofit 2.9.0 javadoc (com.squareup.retrofit2)

Source: https://javadoc.io/doc/com.squareup.retrofit2/retrofit/2.9.0/index.html

No JavaDoc is released for artifact

com.squareup.retrofit2:retrofit:2.9.0.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/com.squareup.retrofit2/retrofit/2.9.0)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the retrofit-2.9.0-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the retrofit-2.9.0-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.
